name: SKACAP
recent: SKA Capital 于 2026 年 11 月 11 日在 ACE Market 上市，IPO 发行价为 RM0.43，首日收盘上涨 15%。上市后，董事与主要股东出现股权变动，公司刚公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩，营收 1.279 亿令吉，净利 1,437 万令吉。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 11 月 11 日在 Bursa Malaysia ACE Market 上市，IPO 发行价为每股 RM0.43。
首次公开募股包括公开发行 168,075,500 股新股及献售 72,400,000 股现有股份。
公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩，营收 1.279 亿令吉，净利 1,437 万令吉。
risks: 董事总经理 Dato' Subas Kumar A/L Ambairam 在 IPO 中献售 72,400,000 股现有股份。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度，公司营收为 1.279 亿令吉，净利为 1,437 万令吉，净利率 11.2%。

recent_en: SKA Capital listed on the ACE Market on 11 November 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.43 and closed 15% higher on debut. Post-listing, there were changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including open-market disposals by a director. The company just reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM127.941 million and net profit of RM14.37 million.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia on 11 November 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.43 per share.
The IPO comprised a public issue of 168,075,500 new shares and an offer for sale of 72,400,000 existing shares.
The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of RM127.941 million and net profit of RM14.37 million.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Fazrin Azwar Bin Md. Nor disposed of 100,000 shares and 60,000 shares on 11 and 12 November 2026 respectively in the open market.
Managing Director Dato' Subas Kumar A/L Ambairam offered for sale 72,400,000 existing shares under the IPO.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM127.941 million and net profit was RM14.37 million, with a net margin of 11.2%.
